items.text: Billing at a glance. Money is shown per currency and never summed across INR and USD. Internal teams are left out of run rate and receivables. For detail, open Billing Invariant Violations, Invoice Register, AR Collections Aging, Failed Payments, Dunning Recovery, Webhook Lag.

Bare metal cost against what live servers earn. Each server carries its vCPU share of its region's Metal Server cost. Only Paid servers earn cash. Reports: Region Capacity, Server Inventory, Unit Economics, Metal Server Profitability.

operations.raw_sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT c.subscription, c.change_type, c.locked_rate, c.currency,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.subscription ORDER BY c.effective_at DESC, c.creation DESC) AS rn
  FROM `tabSubscription Change` c
  WHERE c.change_type IN ('Created', 'Plan Changed', 'Cancelled')
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.currency = 'INR' THEN l.locked_rate ELSE 0 END) AS run_rate_inr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.currency = 'USD' THEN l.locked_rate ELSE 0 END) AS run_rate_usd,
  COUNT(*) AS subscriptions
FROM latest l
JOIN `tabSubscription` s ON s.name = l.subscription
WHERE l.rn = 1 AND l.change_type != 'Cancelled' AND s.enabled = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabTax Profile` tp WHERE tp.team = s.team AND tp.is_internal = 1)

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabWebhook Event` WHERE status = 'Failed'
    OR (status = 'Received' AND creation < NOW() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)) AS webhooks_stuck,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabInvoice` WHERE erpnext_sync_status = 'Failed') AS sync_failed,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabInvoice` WHERE status = 'Draft' AND hold_reason IS NOT NULL AND hold_reason != '') AS on_hold,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabSubscription` WHERE enabled = 1 AND account_standing IN ('Past Due', 'Suspended')) AS past_due

SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(creation), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(creation) - 1 DAY) AS month, currency,
  SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'Credit' AND reference_type = 'Promotion' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS promotional,
  SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'Credit' AND reference_type IN ('Top-up', 'Payment Method') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS purchased,
  SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'Debit' AND reference_type = 'Invoice' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS spent,
  SUM(CASE WHEN reference_type = 'Expiry' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS expired
FROM `tabCredit Ledger Entry`
WHERE creation >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
GROUP BY month, currency
ORDER BY month, currency

SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(period_start), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(period_start) - 1 DAY) AS month, currency,
  COUNT(*) AS invoices,
  SUM(total) AS invoiced, SUM(credit_applied) AS paid_by_credit, SUM(amount_paid) AS collected,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('Open', 'Overdue') THEN expected_collection ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding
FROM `tabInvoice`
WHERE invoice_type = 'Billable' AND status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Waived')
  AND period_start >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
GROUP BY month, currency
ORDER BY month, currency

WITH used AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(COALESCE(vcpus, 0)) AS vcpus, SUM(COALESCE(memory_megabytes, 0)) / 1024 AS memory_gib,
    SUM(COALESCE(disk_gigabytes, 0)) AS disk_gib, COUNT(*) AS servers
  FROM `tabVirtual Machine` WHERE status NOT IN ('Terminated', 'Failed') GROUP BY region
),
metal AS (
  SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS machines, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus, SUM(memory_gib) AS memory_gib,
    SUM(disk_gib) AS disk_gib, SUM(cost_per_month_inr) AS cost
  FROM `tabMetal Server` WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY region
),
regions AS (SELECT region FROM metal UNION SELECT region FROM used)
SELECT r.region,
  COALESCE(m.machines, 0) AS machines, COALESCE(u.servers, 0) AS servers,
  COALESCE(m.vcpus, 0) AS vcpus, COALESCE(u.vcpus, 0) AS allocated_vcpus,
  ROUND(100 * COALESCE(u.vcpus, 0) / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 1) AS vcpu_used_percent,
  ROUND(100 * COALESCE(u.memory_gib, 0) / NULLIF(m.memory_gib, 0), 1) AS memory_used_percent,
  ROUND(100 * COALESCE(u.disk_gib, 0) / NULLIF(m.disk_gib, 0), 1) AS disk_used_percent,
  COALESCE(m.cost, 0) AS metal_cost_inr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(m.cost, 0) / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 2) AS cost_per_vcpu_inr,
  GREATEST(COALESCE(m.cost, 0) - COALESCE(u.vcpus, 0) * COALESCE(m.cost / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 0), 0) AS idle_cost_inr
FROM regions r LEFT JOIN metal m ON m.region = r.region LEFT JOIN used u ON u.region = r.region
ORDER BY r.region

SELECT DATE(creation) AS day, status, COUNT(*) AS attempts
FROM `tabPayment Attempt`
WHERE creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY day, status
ORDER BY day

SELECT DATE(DATE_SUB(creation, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(creation) DAY)) AS week, gateway,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(status = 'Captured') / NULLIF(SUM(status IN ('Captured', 'Failed')), 0), 1) AS success_percent
FROM `tabPayment Attempt`
WHERE creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK
GROUP BY week, gateway
ORDER BY week

SELECT
  ROUND(100 * SUM(status = 'Captured') / NULLIF(SUM(status IN ('Captured', 'Failed')), 0), 1) AS success_percent,
  COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Failed' AND creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY), 0) AS failed_7_days,
  COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Initiated' AND creation < NOW() - INTERVAL 1 DAY), 0) AS stuck_attempts
FROM `tabPayment Attempt`
WHERE creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT c.subscription, c.change_type, c.locked_rate, c.currency,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.subscription ORDER BY c.effective_at DESC, c.creation DESC) AS rn
  FROM `tabSubscription Change` c
  WHERE c.change_type IN ('Created', 'Plan Changed', 'Cancelled')
),
metal AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(cost_per_month_inr) AS cost, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus,
    SUM(memory_gib) AS memory_gib, SUM(disk_gib) AS disk_gib, COUNT(*) AS machines
  FROM `tabMetal Server` WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY region
),
rate AS (
  SELECT s.server_id, l.locked_rate, l.currency
  FROM `tabSubscription` s JOIN latest l ON l.subscription = s.name AND l.rn = 1
  WHERE s.enabled = 1 AND s.server_id IS NOT NULL AND s.server_id != '' AND l.change_type != 'Cancelled'
),
servers AS (
  SELECT v.name AS server, v.team, t.team_name, v.region, v.status,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) AS vcpus, COALESCE(v.memory_megabytes, 0) / 1024 AS memory_gib,
    COALESCE(v.disk_gigabytes, 0) AS disk_gib,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabTax Profile` tp WHERE tp.team = v.team AND tp.is_internal = 1) THEN 'Internal'
      WHEN (SELECT MAX(st.trial_state) FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        IN ('Active', 'Ended', 'Deleted') THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabResource Action` ra
          WHERE ra.server = v.name AND ra.action = 'create' AND ra.is_free_trial = 1) THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPayment Method` pm WHERE pm.team = v.team AND pm.status = 'Active')
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabCredit Ledger Entry` e WHERE e.team = v.team AND e.entry_type = 'Credit'
          AND e.reference_type IN ('Top-up', 'Payment Method'))
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabInvoice` i WHERE i.team = v.team AND i.amount_paid > 0) THEN 'Paid'
      ELSE 'Free Credits'
    END AS funding,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) * COALESCE(m.cost / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 0) AS metal_cost_inr,
    COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate,
    COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') AS currency,
    v.atlas_host_id
  FROM `tabVirtual Machine` v
  JOIN `tabTeam` t ON t.name = v.team
  LEFT JOIN metal m ON m.region = v.region
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON r.server_id = v.name
  WHERE v.status NOT IN ('Terminated', 'Failed')
)

SELECT ms.name AS metal_server, ms.region, ms.cost_per_month_inr AS cost_inr, ms.vcpus,
  COUNT(s.server) AS servers,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.funding = 'Paid'), 0) AS paid,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.funding != 'Paid'), 0) AS unpaid,
  COALESCE(SUM(s.vcpus), 0) AS allocated_vcpus,
  ROUND(100 * COALESCE(SUM(s.vcpus), 0) / NULLIF(ms.vcpus, 0), 1) AS vcpu_used_percent,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.funding = 'Paid' AND s.currency = 'INR' THEN s.list_rate ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_inr,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.funding = 'Paid' AND s.currency = 'USD' THEN s.list_rate ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_usd,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.funding = 'Paid' AND s.currency = 'INR' THEN s.list_rate ELSE 0 END), 0)
    - ms.cost_per_month_inr AS margin_inr
FROM `tabMetal Server` ms
LEFT JOIN servers s ON s.atlas_host_id = ms.atlas_host_id AND ms.atlas_host_id IS NOT NULL
WHERE ms.status = 'Active'
GROUP BY ms.name, ms.region, ms.cost_per_month_inr, ms.vcpus
ORDER BY margin_inr DESC

SELECT currency,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) <= 0 THEN expected_collection ELSE 0 END) AS not_due,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN expected_collection ELSE 0 END) AS days_1_30,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN expected_collection ELSE 0 END) AS days_31_60,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN expected_collection ELSE 0 END) AS days_61_90,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), due_date) > 90 THEN expected_collection ELSE 0 END) AS days_over_90
FROM `tabInvoice`
WHERE invoice_type = 'Billable' AND status IN ('Open', 'Overdue') AND expected_collection > 0
GROUP BY currency

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'INR' THEN expected_collection ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outstanding_inr,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'USD' THEN expected_collection ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outstanding_usd,
  COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Open'), 0) AS open_invoices,
  COALESCE(SUM(status = 'Overdue'), 0) AS overdue_invoices,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Overdue' AND currency = 'INR' THEN expected_collection ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_inr,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Overdue' AND currency = 'USD' THEN expected_collection ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue_usd
FROM `tabInvoice`
WHERE invoice_type = 'Billable' AND status IN ('Open', 'Overdue')

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT c.subscription, c.change_type, c.locked_rate, c.currency,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.subscription ORDER BY c.effective_at DESC, c.creation DESC) AS rn
  FROM `tabSubscription Change` c
  WHERE c.change_type IN ('Created', 'Plan Changed', 'Cancelled')
),
metal AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(cost_per_month_inr) AS cost, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus,
    SUM(memory_gib) AS memory_gib, SUM(disk_gib) AS disk_gib, COUNT(*) AS machines
  FROM `tabMetal Server` WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY region
),
rate AS (
  SELECT s.server_id, l.locked_rate, l.currency
  FROM `tabSubscription` s JOIN latest l ON l.subscription = s.name AND l.rn = 1
  WHERE s.enabled = 1 AND s.server_id IS NOT NULL AND s.server_id != '' AND l.change_type != 'Cancelled'
),
servers AS (
  SELECT v.name AS server, v.team, t.team_name, v.region, v.status,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) AS vcpus, COALESCE(v.memory_megabytes, 0) / 1024 AS memory_gib,
    COALESCE(v.disk_gigabytes, 0) AS disk_gib,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabTax Profile` tp WHERE tp.team = v.team AND tp.is_internal = 1) THEN 'Internal'
      WHEN (SELECT MAX(st.trial_state) FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        IN ('Active', 'Ended', 'Deleted') THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabResource Action` ra
          WHERE ra.server = v.name AND ra.action = 'create' AND ra.is_free_trial = 1) THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPayment Method` pm WHERE pm.team = v.team AND pm.status = 'Active')
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabCredit Ledger Entry` e WHERE e.team = v.team AND e.entry_type = 'Credit'
          AND e.reference_type IN ('Top-up', 'Payment Method'))
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabInvoice` i WHERE i.team = v.team AND i.amount_paid > 0) THEN 'Paid'
      ELSE 'Free Credits'
    END AS funding,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) * COALESCE(m.cost / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 0) AS metal_cost_inr,
    COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate,
    COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') AS currency,
    v.atlas_host_id
  FROM `tabVirtual Machine` v
  JOIN `tabTeam` t ON t.name = v.team
  LEFT JOIN metal m ON m.region = v.region
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON r.server_id = v.name
  WHERE v.status NOT IN ('Terminated', 'Failed')
)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(funding = 'Paid'), 0) AS paid, COALESCE(SUM(funding = 'Free Credits'), 0) AS free_credits,
  COALESCE(SUM(funding = 'Internal'), 0) AS internal, COALESCE(SUM(funding = 'Trial'), 0) AS trial,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN funding != 'Paid' THEN metal_cost_inr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unpaid_cost_inr
FROM servers

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT c.subscription, c.change_type, c.locked_rate, c.currency,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.subscription ORDER BY c.effective_at DESC, c.creation DESC) AS rn
  FROM `tabSubscription Change` c
  WHERE c.change_type IN ('Created', 'Plan Changed', 'Cancelled')
),
metal AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(cost_per_month_inr) AS cost, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus,
    SUM(memory_gib) AS memory_gib, SUM(disk_gib) AS disk_gib, COUNT(*) AS machines
  FROM `tabMetal Server` WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY region
),
rate AS (
  SELECT s.server_id, l.locked_rate, l.currency
  FROM `tabSubscription` s JOIN latest l ON l.subscription = s.name AND l.rn = 1
  WHERE s.enabled = 1 AND s.server_id IS NOT NULL AND s.server_id != '' AND l.change_type != 'Cancelled'
),
servers AS (
  SELECT v.name AS server, v.team, t.team_name, v.region, v.status,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) AS vcpus, COALESCE(v.memory_megabytes, 0) / 1024 AS memory_gib,
    COALESCE(v.disk_gigabytes, 0) AS disk_gib,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabTax Profile` tp WHERE tp.team = v.team AND tp.is_internal = 1) THEN 'Internal'
      WHEN (SELECT MAX(st.trial_state) FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        IN ('Active', 'Ended', 'Deleted') THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabResource Action` ra
          WHERE ra.server = v.name AND ra.action = 'create' AND ra.is_free_trial = 1) THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPayment Method` pm WHERE pm.team = v.team AND pm.status = 'Active')
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabCredit Ledger Entry` e WHERE e.team = v.team AND e.entry_type = 'Credit'
          AND e.reference_type IN ('Top-up', 'Payment Method'))
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabInvoice` i WHERE i.team = v.team AND i.amount_paid > 0) THEN 'Paid'
      ELSE 'Free Credits'
    END AS funding,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) * COALESCE(m.cost / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 0) AS metal_cost_inr,
    COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate,
    COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') AS currency,
    v.atlas_host_id
  FROM `tabVirtual Machine` v
  JOIN `tabTeam` t ON t.name = v.team
  LEFT JOIN metal m ON m.region = v.region
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON r.server_id = v.name
  WHERE v.status NOT IN ('Terminated', 'Failed')
)

SELECT funding, COUNT(*) AS servers, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus,
  SUM(metal_cost_inr) AS metal_cost_inr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'INR' THEN list_rate ELSE 0 END) AS list_value_inr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'USD' THEN list_rate ELSE 0 END) AS list_value_usd,
  SUM(CASE WHEN funding = 'Paid' AND currency = 'INR' THEN list_rate ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_inr,
  SUM(CASE WHEN funding = 'Paid' AND currency = 'USD' THEN list_rate ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_usd
FROM servers
GROUP BY funding
ORDER BY FIELD(funding, 'Internal', 'Trial', 'Paid', 'Free Credits')

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(account_standing, ''), 'Current') AS standing, COUNT(*) AS subscriptions
FROM `tabSubscription`
WHERE enabled = 1
GROUP BY standing

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT c.subscription, c.change_type, c.locked_rate, c.currency,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.subscription ORDER BY c.effective_at DESC, c.creation DESC) AS rn
  FROM `tabSubscription Change` c
  WHERE c.change_type IN ('Created', 'Plan Changed', 'Cancelled')
),
metal AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(cost_per_month_inr) AS cost, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus,
    SUM(memory_gib) AS memory_gib, SUM(disk_gib) AS disk_gib, COUNT(*) AS machines
  FROM `tabMetal Server` WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY region
),
rate AS (
  SELECT s.server_id, l.locked_rate, l.currency
  FROM `tabSubscription` s JOIN latest l ON l.subscription = s.name AND l.rn = 1
  WHERE s.enabled = 1 AND s.server_id IS NOT NULL AND s.server_id != '' AND l.change_type != 'Cancelled'
),
servers AS (
  SELECT v.name AS server, v.team, t.team_name, v.region, v.status,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) AS vcpus, COALESCE(v.memory_megabytes, 0) / 1024 AS memory_gib,
    COALESCE(v.disk_gigabytes, 0) AS disk_gib,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabTax Profile` tp WHERE tp.team = v.team AND tp.is_internal = 1) THEN 'Internal'
      WHEN (SELECT MAX(st.trial_state) FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        IN ('Active', 'Ended', 'Deleted') THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabResource Action` ra
          WHERE ra.server = v.name AND ra.action = 'create' AND ra.is_free_trial = 1) THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPayment Method` pm WHERE pm.team = v.team AND pm.status = 'Active')
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabCredit Ledger Entry` e WHERE e.team = v.team AND e.entry_type = 'Credit'
          AND e.reference_type IN ('Top-up', 'Payment Method'))
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabInvoice` i WHERE i.team = v.team AND i.amount_paid > 0) THEN 'Paid'
      ELSE 'Free Credits'
    END AS funding,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) * COALESCE(m.cost / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 0) AS metal_cost_inr,
    COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate,
    COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') AS currency,
    v.atlas_host_id
  FROM `tabVirtual Machine` v
  JOIN `tabTeam` t ON t.name = v.team
  LEFT JOIN metal m ON m.region = v.region
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON r.server_id = v.name
  WHERE v.status NOT IN ('Terminated', 'Failed')
)

SELECT team, team_name, funding, currency, COUNT(*) AS servers, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus,
  SUM(metal_cost_inr) AS metal_cost_inr, SUM(list_rate) AS list_value,
  SUM(CASE WHEN funding = 'Paid' THEN list_rate ELSE 0 END) AS revenue
FROM servers
GROUP BY team, team_name, funding, currency
ORDER BY metal_cost_inr DESC
LIMIT 25

SELECT i.team, t.team_name, i.currency, COUNT(*) AS invoices,
  SUM(i.expected_collection) AS outstanding, MIN(i.due_date) AS oldest_due
FROM `tabInvoice` i JOIN `tabTeam` t ON t.name = i.team
WHERE i.invoice_type = 'Billable' AND i.status IN ('Open', 'Overdue') AND i.expected_collection > 0
GROUP BY i.team, t.team_name, i.currency
ORDER BY outstanding DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT c.subscription, c.change_type, c.locked_rate, c.currency,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.subscription ORDER BY c.effective_at DESC, c.creation DESC) AS rn
  FROM `tabSubscription Change` c
  WHERE c.change_type IN ('Created', 'Plan Changed', 'Cancelled')
),
metal AS (
  SELECT region, SUM(cost_per_month_inr) AS cost, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus,
    SUM(memory_gib) AS memory_gib, SUM(disk_gib) AS disk_gib, COUNT(*) AS machines
  FROM `tabMetal Server` WHERE status = 'Active' GROUP BY region
),
rate AS (
  SELECT s.server_id, l.locked_rate, l.currency
  FROM `tabSubscription` s JOIN latest l ON l.subscription = s.name AND l.rn = 1
  WHERE s.enabled = 1 AND s.server_id IS NOT NULL AND s.server_id != '' AND l.change_type != 'Cancelled'
),
servers AS (
  SELECT v.name AS server, v.team, t.team_name, v.region, v.status,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) AS vcpus, COALESCE(v.memory_megabytes, 0) / 1024 AS memory_gib,
    COALESCE(v.disk_gigabytes, 0) AS disk_gib,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabTax Profile` tp WHERE tp.team = v.team AND tp.is_internal = 1) THEN 'Internal'
      WHEN (SELECT MAX(st.trial_state) FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        IN ('Active', 'Ended', 'Deleted') THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabSite` st WHERE st.server = v.name AND st.trial_state != '')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabResource Action` ra
          WHERE ra.server = v.name AND ra.action = 'create' AND ra.is_free_trial = 1) THEN 'Trial'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabPayment Method` pm WHERE pm.team = v.team AND pm.status = 'Active')
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabCredit Ledger Entry` e WHERE e.team = v.team AND e.entry_type = 'Credit'
          AND e.reference_type IN ('Top-up', 'Payment Method'))
        OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `tabInvoice` i WHERE i.team = v.team AND i.amount_paid > 0) THEN 'Paid'
      ELSE 'Free Credits'
    END AS funding,
    COALESCE(v.vcpus, 0) * COALESCE(m.cost / NULLIF(m.vcpus, 0), 0) AS metal_cost_inr,
    COALESCE(r.locked_rate, 0) AS list_rate,
    COALESCE(r.currency, 'INR') AS currency,
    v.atlas_host_id
  FROM `tabVirtual Machine` v
  JOIN `tabTeam` t ON t.name = v.team
  LEFT JOIN metal m ON m.region = v.region
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON r.server_id = v.name
  WHERE v.status NOT IN ('Terminated', 'Failed')
)

SELECT region, funding, SUM(vcpus) AS vcpus
FROM servers GROUP BY region, funding ORDER BY region

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'INR' THEN balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS balance_inr,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'USD' THEN balance ELSE 0 END), 0) AS balance_usd
FROM `tabCredit Wallet`

SELECT DATE(creation) AS day,
  ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, creation, processed_at)), 1) AS average_seconds,
  MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, creation, processed_at)) AS worst_seconds
FROM `tabWebhook Event`
WHERE status = 'Processed' AND processed_at IS NOT NULL AND creation >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day
